description:
This source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph, which is a specialized injector for automatically inserting paragraph tags (

) into HTML content based on double-spacing patterns. It contains methods for handling text and element tokens, splitting text into paragraphs, and managing token flow to ensure well-formed HTML output.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph
classes.description: A class responsible for inserting paragraph tags into HTML text based on double newline patterns, ensuring the output is well-formed HTML.

methods.name: _pStart
methods.description:
Creates and returns a new start token for the

element, configuring it to be well-formed.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes text tokens to determine if paragraph tags should be inserted based on double newline patterns and current context.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description:
Processes element tokens to manage insertion of

tags within inline and block elements, maintaining proper paragraph structure.

methods.name: _splitText
methods.description: Splits a block of text into multiple paragraph tokens based on double newlines and manages start and end paragraph tokens accordingly.

methods.name: _isInline
methods.description: Determines whether a given token is inline, i.e., allowed within paragraph tags, based on the HTML definition.

methods.name: _pLookAhead
methods.description:
Looks ahead in the token sequence to assess whether a

tag should be inserted before upcoming content.

methods.name: _checkNeedsP
methods.description: Checks whether the current token sequence indicates the need to insert a paragraph start tag.
